name: Obsidian Daily
author: Luca Nerlich
description: View and manage Obsidian daily note todos from the Omarchy bar. Set vaultPath or OBSIDIAN_VAULT_ROOT.

barWidget.description: Shows today's done/total daily-note todos and opens a panel to check, add, and carry over items.

schema.label: Vault path
schema.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault. Overrides OBSIDIAN_VAULT_ROOT when set.

schema.label: Open todos only
schema.description: When the panel opens, hide completed checkboxes by default. Can still be toggled in the panel.

schema.label: Todo heading
schema.description: Only show todos under this markdown heading (e.g. Todos or Tasks). Empty = all todos.

schema.label: Insert heading
schema.description: Heading new todos are added under (e.g. Inbox). Empty = follow Todo heading, then Tasks/Todos.

schema.label: Hide when done
schema.description: Conceal the bar widget when today's note has no open todos.

schema.label: Hide when empty
schema.description: Conceal the bar widget when there is no note or no todos for today.

schema.label: Sort order
schema.description: How todos are ordered in the panel: 'default' (file order, new todos append to the bottom), 'newest' (newest first / top), or 'openFirst' (uncompleted first).
